items.q: No, no, no, Lockjaw was a demon too, you know?

ctx.x: No, no, no, Lockjaw was a demon too, you know?

Lockjaw was a natural demon. He is. No, no, but this -- he had to play up to this place, Metcalf's place. And he and Earl Bostic hooked up there and he was, he was making wind, fast like wind, and Earl Bostic was coming on like lightening wind, put lightening to him. Earl Bostic -- really went in to his stuff, and see, Charlie Parker may not have been an alcoholic drinker, drinking man, but he went to the bar and got three or four doubles and Earl Bostic was still playing and running those running those snakes,…
